convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for BlauTStochI indicator and depends on two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing algorithms and trading logic. Custom indicator and external dependencies require manual replication.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars for indicator calculation

other_exits: Breakdown mode: long closes when indicator crosses below zero; short closes when indicator crosses above zero

Twist mode: long closes when indicator direction changes from falling to rising (Value[1]>Value[2] triggers BuyPosClose); short closes when indicator direction changes from rising to falling (Value[1]<Value[2] triggers SellPosClose)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM>0: deposit fraction; MM<0: absolute lot size. MMMode selects between LOT, PCT, and other margin modes via TradeAlgorithms.mqh

custom_logic_notes: Two entry algorithms selectable via Mode enum: (1) 'breakdown' - enters when BlauTStochI crosses zero line (Value[1]>0 and Value[0]<=0 for buy, Value[1]<0 and Value[0]>=0 for sell); (2) 'twist' - enters on direction change (Value[1]<Value[2] declining, then Value[0]>=Value[1] turning up for buy; Value[1]>Value[2] rising, then Value[0]<=Value[1] turning down for sell). SignalBar input (default=1) shifts which bar is used for signal detection, allowing delayed signal confirmation. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose booleans independently gate each trade action. Trading functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose) and GlobalVariableDel_ are from TradeAlgorithms.mqh. CIsNewBar class handles new bar detection. CXMA class from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh calculates starting bars for indicator warmup.
python_conversion_notes: BlauTStochI is a triple-smoothed stochastic momentum indicator from William Blau's work. Must replicate the full smoothing chain: (1) calculate raw momentum, (2) apply first EMA smoothing (XLength1=5), (3) apply second EMA smoothing (XLength2=8), (4) apply third EMA smoothing (XLength3=3), (5) normalize as stochastic index. The XMA_Method supports multiple smoothing types (JJMA, VIDIA, AMA beyond just EMA) via SmoothAlgorithms.mqh - these non-standard smoothers must be ported if XMA_Method is changed from default. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides position open/close wrappers that handle lot sizing (MM>0=fraction, MM<0=fixed lots), SL/TP placement, and deviation checks - must replicate this full logic. The 'twist' mode direction-change detection requires 3 consecutive indicator values. SignalBar=1 means signals are evaluated on the previous closed bar, not the current forming bar, which avoids repainting. SL/TP are in points (not pips) - no digit adjustment needed since values are passed directly to trade functions.
